spans.s:
गिर् 1. गिर्, ईर्, ईर्, ईर् (fr. 1. गॄ), Ved. ad-
dressing, invoking, praising; (ईर्), f. invocation, ad-
dressing with praise, praise, verse, song; speech,
speaking, language, voice, words (e. g. मानुषीं
गिरं कृ, to assume a human voice; गिराम् प्र-
भविष्णुः, ‘lord of speech or words,’ an epithet of
Bṛhaspati, regent of the planet Jupiter); a N. of
Sarasvatī, the goddess of speech; fame, celebrity;
[cf. Hib. gair, ‘an outcry, a shout;’ Gr. γῆρυς.]
—१. गिर्-ईश, अस्, m. an epithet of Bṛhaspati; [cf.
गीष्-पति.]
—गिर्-वणस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. delighting
in invocations, fond of praise, an epithet of Indra and
Agni.
—गिर्-वणस्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. fond of hymns
or praise, an epithet of Indra.
—गिर्-वन्, आ, आ, अ,
Ved. addressed with many invocations, receiving much
praise.
—गिर्व-वाह्, ट्, ट्, ट्, Ved. bearing one who is
addressed with many hymns.
—गिर्-वाहस्, आस्, आस्,
अस्, Ved. one to whom invocations are addressed,
praised in song, an epithet of Indra &c.
—गीः-
पति = गीष्-पति.
—गी-रथ (गिर्-र˚), अस्, m. ‘the
vehicle of words,’ an epithet of Bṛhaspati.
—गीर्-
देवी, f. the goddess of speech, Sarasvatī.
—गीर्-पति
= गीष्-पति.
—गीर्-लता, f., N. of a plant, = महा-
ज्योतिष्मती.
—गीर्-वाण, अस्, m. a god, a deity
(‘whose arrow is speech;’ or perhaps only a cor-
ruption fr. गिर्-वणस्.)
—गीर्वाण-कुसुम, अम्, n.
the flower of the gods, cloves.
—गीष्-पति, इस्, m.
the lord of speech, a N. of Bṛhaspati, the regent of
the planet Jupiter and preceptor of the gods; a Paṇḍit,
a learned man.
—गीस्-तरा, f. excellent speech, a
good voice.

गिर् 2. गिर् (fr. 2. गॄ), swallowing, (at the
end of compounds, e. g. in गर-गिर् and मुहुर्-गिर्.)

गिरा, f. speech, speaking; voice.
—गिरा-वृध्,
त्, त्, त्, Ved. delighting in being praised; (Sāy.)
thriving by praise (as a god).

गिर 2. गिर, at the end of an adverbial
compound = गिरि (e. g. अनु-गिरम्, near the moun-
tain).
गिरित, अस्, आ, अम्, swallowed, eaten.

गिरि गिरि, इस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 2. गॄ;
perhaps originally गरि or गरु, and related to गुरु,
गरिमन्), a hill, a mountain, a rock, an elevation,
a rising-ground (in the foregoing senses often con-
nected in the Veda with पर्वत, e. g. पर्वतो
गिरिः, explained by Sāy. as a mountain having
many parts); a cloud (this last sense is often given
to गिरि by the commentators on Vedic works); a term
for the number eight, because of the eight mountains
surrounding the mountain Meru; a wooden ball, with
which children play [cf. गिरिक and गिरि-गुड]; a
disease of the eyes; a peculiar defect in quicksilver;
a honorific title given to one of the ten orders of the
Das-nāmī Gosains; N. of a son of Śvaphalka [cf.
[]
गिरि-क्षिप]; (इस्), f. swallowing; a rat, a small
rat, a mouse [cf. गिरिका]; (इस्, इस्, इ), venerable,
respectable, worshipful; [cf. Zend gairi; Slav.
gora; Afghan. ghur; cf. also गरीयस्, गरिष्ठ,
गरिमन्.]
—गिरि-कच्छप, अस्, m. a kind of tor-
toise living in mountains.
—गिरि-कण्टक, अस्, m.
Indra's thunderbolt.
—गिरि-कदम्ब or गिरि-क-
दम्बक, अस्, m. a species of the Kadamba tree,
mountain Kadamba; [cf. नीप and धारा-क-
दम्ब.]
—गिरि-कदली, f. the mountain or wild
Kadalī.
—गिरि-कन्दर, अस्, m. a cave, a cavern.
—गिरि-कर्णा, f. the plant Clitoria Ternatea; [cf.
अ-पराजिता.]
—गिरि-कर्णिका, f. the earth; the plant
Clitoria Ternatea; a species of Kiṇihī with white
blossoms.
—गिरि-कर्णी, f. the plant Clitoria Ternatea
[cf. the preceding]; another plant, Alhagi Maurorum
= कच्छुरा.
—गिरि-काण, अस्, m. a blind or one-
eyed man, one blind from a particular disease.
—गिरि-कानन, अम्, n. a mountain-grove.
—गिरि-
कूट, अम्, n. the summit of a mountain.
—गिरि-
क्षित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. living in mountains or on high,
as Viṣṇu; (त्), m., N. of an Auccāmanyava; [cf.
गैरिक्षित.]
—गिरि-क्षिप, अस्, m., N. of a son of
Śvaphalka; [cf. अरिक्षिप and गिरि.]
—गिरि-गङ्गा,
f., N. of a river.
—गिरि-गुड, अस्, m. a ball for play-
ing with.
—गिरि-गुहा, f. a mountain-cave.
—गिरि-
गैरिक-धातु, उस्, m. = गैरिक, red chalk.
—गिरि-
गैरिकधातु-वत्, ind. like red chalk.
—गिरि-चर,
अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. living in or inhabiting mountains.
—गिरि-चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, living in mountains.
—गिरि-
ज, अस्, आ, अम्, mountain-born, mountaineer; (अस्),
m. the Mahwa tree, Bassia, = मधूल; N. of a man
with the patronymic Bābhravya; (आ), f., N. of several
plants, viz. a kind of lemon tree; a plant considered
as a white species of Rasnā [cf. रस्ना]; the shaddock
or pumple-mouse, Citrus Decumana; also = श्वेत-
वुह्ना, क्षुद्र-पाषाण, गिरि-कदली, कारी, त्रा-
यमाणा; a kind of jasmine, मल्लिका; a N. of the
goddess Pārvatī, as the daughter of the personified
Himālaya mountain; (अम्), n. talc; benzoin or gum
benjamin; it is also confounded with another gum
resin called styrax; red chalk; bitumen; iron.
—गिरिजा-कुमार, अस्, m., N. of a pupil of Śaṅka-
rācārya.
—गिरिजा-पति, इस्, m. an epithet of Śiva,
the husband of Pārvatī.
—गिरिजामल (˚ज-अम्˚),
अम्, n. talc.
—गिरि-जाल, अम्, n. a range of moun-
tains.
—गिरिजा-सुत, अस्, m., N. of the chief of a
sect worshipping Gaṇeśa.
—गिरि-ज्वर, अस्, m. Indra's
thunderbolt; [cf. गिरि-कण्टक.]
—गिरि-णद्ध or
गिरि-नद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, enclosed by a mountain.
—गिरि-णितम्ब or गिरि-नितम्ब, अस्, m. the declivity
of a mountain.
—गिरि-त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. ruling over
mountains; epithet of Rudra-Śiva.
—गिरि-दुर्ग,
अस्, आ, अम्, or अम्, n. of difficult access in consequence
of being surrounded by mountains; a hill-fort or any
stronghold amongst mountains.
—गिरि-द्वार, अम्,
n. a mountain-pass.
—गिरि-धर, अस्, m., N. of a
copyist of the seventeenth century.
—गिरि-धातु,
उस्, m. different kinds of earth or minerals in the
interior of a mountain; red chalk.
—गिरि-ध्वज,
अस्, m. Indra's thunderbolt; [cf. गिरि-कण्टक and
गिरि-ज्वर.]
—गिरि-नगर, अम्, n., N. of a town
in Dakṣiṇā-patha.
—गिरि-नदी or गिरि-णदी, f. a
mountain-torrent.
—गिरि-नन्दिनी, f. daughter of a
mountain, a mountain-stream.
—गिरि-निम्नगा, f. a
mountain-torrent.
—गिरि-निम्ब, अस्, m., N. of a
plant, = महारिष्ट.
—गिरि-पीलु, उस्, m., N. of
a fruit tree, = परुष.
—गिरि-पुर, अम्, n. moun-
tain-town or N. of a town.
—गिरि-पुष्पक, अम्,
n. a fragrant resin, benzoin.
—गिरि-पृष्ठ, अम्, n.
the top of a hill.
—गिरि-प्रपात, अस्, m. the declivity
of a mountain.
—गिरि-प्रस्थ, अस्, m. the table-land
of a mountain.
—गिरि-प्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, fond of or
frequenting mountains; (आ), f. the female of the
Bos Grunniens.
—गिरि-बान्धव, अस्, m. a friend of
the mountains, an epithet of Śiva.
—गिरि-बुध्न,
अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. resting on a mountain, produced
on a hill; [cf. अद्रि-बुध्न.]
—गिरि-भिद्, त्, त्, त्,
breaking through the mountains, as a river; (त्), f.
the plant Plectranthus Scutellarioides.
—गिरि-भू,
ऊस्, ऊस्, उ, mountain-born, mountaineer; (ऊस्), f., N.
[]
of a plant, = क्षुद्र-पाषाण-भेदा; a small
stone (?); an epithet of Pārvatī, the wife of Śiva.
—गिरि-भ्रज्, ट्, ट्, ट्, Ved. breaking forth from
mountains; (Sāy.) falling from the clouds.
—गिरि-
मल्लिका, f. the plant Wrightia Antidysenterica; [cf.
कुट-ज.]
—गिरि-मात्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having the size
or dimensions of a mountain.
—गिरि-मान, अस्, आ,
अम्, having the extent or dimensions of a mountain;
(अस्), m. a large and powerful elephant.
—गिरि-माल
and गिरि-मालक, अस्, m., N. of a tree.
—गिरि-
मृद्, त्, f. red chalk, mountain soil; [cf. गैरिक.]
—गिरिमृद्-भव, अम्, n. red chalk.
—गिरि-
मेद, अस्, m. a fetid Mimosa, = अरि-मेद.
—गिरि-
राज्, ट्, m. the king of the mountains, the Himavat (?).
—गिरि-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, living on or in mountains,
being or produced in them; (ई), m. a kind of bulb-
ous plant, a large kind of Arum.
—गिरि-व्रज, अस्,
m., N. of the capital of Magadha.
—गिरि-श, अस्, आ,
अम्, or (अस्), m. inhabiting or frequenting moun-
tains, an epithet of Rudra-Śiva.
—गिरि-शन्त, अस्,
आ, अम्, Ved. inhabiting or frequenting mountains.
—गिरि-शय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. inhabiting mountains.
—गिरि-शाल, अस्, m. a kind of bird.
—गिरि-शालिनी,
f. the plant Clitoria Ternatea.
—गिरि-शृङ्ग, अस्,
m. an epithet of Gaṇeśa; the peak of a mountain.
—गिरि-षद्, त्, त्, त्, sitting on mountains; an epi-
thet of Rudra.
—गिरि-ष्ठा, आस्, आस्, अम्, or गिरि-
ष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. स्था), inhabiting or frequenting
mountains; epithet of the Maruts and of the Soma
plant which is found in mountains.
—गिरि-सर्प,
अस्, m. a kind of snake.
—गिरि-सानु, उ, n. table-
land.
—गिरि-सार, अस्, m. iron; tin; an epithet of
the Malaya mountains, situated in the south of India.
—गिरिसार-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made of iron, iron.
—गिरि-सुता, f. the daughter of the mountain Hima-
vat; an epithet of Pārvatī, the wife of Śiva.
—गिरि-
सेन, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—गिरि-स्रवा, f. a
mountain-stream, a torrent.
—गिरि-ह्वा, f. another
N. of the plant गिरि-कर्णिका, Clitoria Ternatea.
—गिरीन्द्र (˚रि-इन्˚), अस्, m. a prince among the
mountains, a high mountain; a term for the number
eight; [cf. गिरि.] — 2. गिरीश (˚रि-ईश), अस्, m. the
prince of the mountains, a N. of the Himālaya, the
snowy mountains on the north of Hindūstan, or
the range personified; an epithet of Śiva; a N. of the
eleventh Rudra: (for 1. गिरीश see under 1. गिर्.)
—गिर्य्-आह्वा, f. = गिरि-ह्वा.

गिरिक, अस्, m. the inhabitant of a mountain (?);
a N. of Śiva; a ball for playing with [cf. गिरि and
गिरियक]; N. of a chief of the Nāga or serpent-
race; N. of a certain weaver in a Buddhist work;
also called चण्डगिरिक; (आ), f. a mouse, a small
rat; N. of the wife of Vasu, daughter of the moun-
tain Kolāhala and of the river Śaktimatī.

गिरियक or गिरियाक or गिरीयक, अस्, m. a ball
for playing with; [cf. गिरि and गिरि-गुड.]

गिरीश 1. 2. गिरीश, &c. See under 1. गिर्
and under गिरि above.

गीर्ण 1. गीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 1. गॄ), praised.
1. गीर्णि, इस्, f. praise, applause; fame, celebrity.
गीर्ण 2. गीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, swallowed.
गीर्वि, इस्, इस्, इ, swallowing, devouring.
